title: ORDER BY DESC puts BLANK after negative numbers
query: EVALUATE Nums ORDER BY Nums[N] DESC

source.supports: ASC is the default and sorts ascending; the page does not say where BLANK goes

source.quote: Blank evaluates to zero when performing a comparison
source.supports: in a comparison BLANK counts as zero (or the empty string, or FALSE)

derivation: Nums[N] by Id: -5 (1), BLANK (2), 3 (3), -1 (4), 10 (5). BLANK is taken as lower than every number, so descending order is 10, 3, -1, -5, BLANK: Ids 5, 3, 4, 1, 2.
alternative: No source states where ORDER BY puts BLANK. If the sort treats BLANK as 0, the order is 10, 3, BLANK, -1, -5: Ids 5, 3, 2, 4, 1.
